arxiv-2211-05592.title: Towards efficient and generic entanglement detection by machine learning
arxiv-2211-05592.creator: Jue Xu, Qi Zhao
arxiv-2211-05592.description: Abstract Detection of entanglement is an indispensable step to practical quantum computation and communication. Compared with the conventional entanglement witness method based on fidelity, we propose a flexible, machine learning assisted entanglement detection protocol that is robust to different types of noises and sample efficient.

arxiv-2308-08668.title: A unified approach to Quasiregular Linearization in the plane
arxiv-2308-08668.creator: Alastair N. Fletcher, Jacob Pratscher
arxiv-2308-08668.description: Abstract . We generalize the classical König’s and Böttcher’s Theorems in complex dynamics to certain quasiregular mappings in the plane. Our approach to these results is unified in the sense that it does not depend on the local injectivity, or not, of the map at the fixed point.

arxiv-2310-15849.title: A Resilient Framework for 5G-Edge-Connected UAVs based on Switching Edge-MPC and Onboard-PID Control
arxiv-2310-15849.creator: Gerasimos Damigos, Achilleas Santi Seisa, Sumeet Gajanan Satpute, Tore Lindgren, George, Nikolakopoulos
arxiv-2310-15849.description: Abstract In recent years, the need for resources for handling processes with high computational complexity for mobile robots is becoming increasingly urgent. More specifically, robots need to autonomously operate in a robust and continuous manner, while keeping high performance, a need that led to the utilization of edge computing to offload many computationally demanding and time-critical robotic procedures.

arxiv-2510-00702.title: Asymptotic Schwarzschild solutions in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity and their observable effects on the photon sphere of black holes
arxiv-2510-00702.creator: Miguel Aparicio Resco
arxiv-2510-00702.description: Abstract We investigate asymptotic Schwarzschild exterior solutions in the context of modified gravity theories, specifically within the framework of f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity, where the asymptotic behavior recovers the standard Schwarzschild solution of General Relativity. Unlike previous studies that rely mainly on analytical approximations, our approach combines asymptotic analysis with numerical integration of the underlying differential equations.

arxiv-2512-09435.title: UniPart: Part-Level 3D Generation with Unified 3D Geom–Seg Latents
arxiv-2512-09435.creator: Xufan He, Yushuang Wu, Xiaoyang Guo, Chongjie Ye, Jiaqing Zhou, Tianlei Hu, Xiaoguang Han, Dong Du
arxiv-2512-09435.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xufan He, Yushuang Wu, Xiaoyang Guo, Chongjie Ye, Jiaqing Zhou, Tianlei Hu, Xiaoguang Han, Dong Du. Part-level 3D generation is essential for applications requiring decomposable and structured 3D synthesis. However, existing methods either rely on implicit part segmentation with limited granularity control or depend on strong external segmenters trained on large annotated datasets. In this work, we observe that part awareness emerges naturally during whole-object geometry learning and propose Geom-Seg VecSet, a unified geometry–segmentation latent representation that jointly encodes object geometry and part-level structure.

pmc-10491676.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell immunotherapy is a novel treatment that genetically modifies the patients’ own T cells to target and kill malignant cells. However, identification of tumour-specific antigens expressed on multiple solid cancer types, remains a major challenge. P2X purinoceptor 7 (P2X7) is a cell surface expressed ATP gated cation channel, and a dysfunctional version of P2X7, named nfP2X7, has been identified on cancer cells from multiple tissues, while being undetectable on healthy cells.

pmc-12551471.title: Efficacy and safety of dexamethasone in postoperative recovery following hysterectomy: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12551471.creator: Kiran Inam, Muhammad Saeed Qazi, Eeshal Fatima, Maryam Arfa Khan, Ahmad Hassan, Iftikhar Khan, Imama Yaseen, Syeda Bakhtawar Ali, Asma Gul, Owais Owais, Farah Shahzad, Anam Ghafoor Azeemi, Husnain Ahmad
pmc-12551471.description: AbstractObjectivesHysterectomy, a common surgical procedure, is frequently associated with moderate-to-severe postoperative pain and a high incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV). Dexamethasone, a corticosteroid, may help alleviate these symptoms; however, existing evidence is largely drawn from mixed surgical populations and does not specifically address its efficacy and safety in hysterectomy patients.

pmc-13062145.title: YASA automated sleep staging performance across seven nights of normal sleep and sleep restriction
pmc-13062145.creator: Zhiyi Chen, Natalya Pruett, Michael K Scullin
pmc-13062145.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Study objectivesThis study aimed to compare YASA’s automated sleep staging to manual staging in the context of a multi-night experimental sleep restriction protocol.MethodsSeventy-five adults (58% female; 57% nonwhite) participated in up to seven nights of laboratory-based polysomnography measurements. The study involved one adaptation night, followed by three nights of normal sleep (9 h time in bed) and three nights of sleep restriction (5.5 h time in bed). Condition order was counterbalanced. Manual sleep staging was performed by a registered polysomnographic technician.

pmc-13435220.creator: Giulia Maj, Alberto Piermartiri, Serena Querio, Marta Bandini, Marco Lombardi, Edoardo Elia, Serena Penpa, Riccardo Mazzucco, Federico Pappalardo, Corrado Cavozza, Alina Gallo, Andrea Audo, Giuseppe Patti, Gioel Gabrio Secco

In contrast, evidence regarding the use of the larger Impella 5+ (5.0/5.5) in this clinical setting remains limited.

pmc-13688983.title: US postmarketed drug removals: Analysis of discontinued and withdrawn drugs
pmc-13688983.creator: Lilly Josephine Bindel, Roland Seifert
pmc-13688983.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Drugs removed from the US market after approval can be either discontinued by the manufacturer or withdrawn by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA). However, a systematic overview is currently lacking. This minireview provides a comprehensive analysis of removed drugs, identifies patterns regarding drug classes, indications, adverse effects, and scientific interest, and compares US removals with the European Union and FDA boxed warnings. A total of 166 drugs were removed between 1955 and 2026, including 88 discontinued and 78 withdrawn drugs.
